title: Melatonin-functionalized zinc oxide nanoparticles enhance salt stress tolerance in Vigna mungo L. by regulating antioxidants and ion homeostasis
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,5056-5073
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00588D, Paper
Sonali Baksi, Km Madhuri Singh, Sangeeta Rani, Pallavi Sharma
In comparison with bare ZnO nanoparticles, melatonin-functionalized ZnO nanoparticles showed improved salt stress tolerance in black gram by significantly increasing growth, photosynthetic pigments, ion homeostasis, and antioxidant enzyme activities.
